description: A dialog commits its colour on close: refused without consent.

error.detail: closing a dialog commits the value it shows; the end user must accept that, then the call carries confirm true

nextStep.message: Closing a dialog that is open would commit the value it shows (the track-colour dialog commits its colour). Ask the user whether to accept that; only after the user agrees, call opentune_manage_ui again with accept_commit: true. Otherwise the user can cancel the dialog in the OpenTune window.
